scope: Standalone Whistler IPv4 TCP/UDP TC Service translation engine. It is not yet attached by the node agent or CNI.

kernel.execution: BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN over real maps and actual compiled TC programs; no live guest or container traffic in this gate.
coverage: TCP and UDP destination NAT and reverse source NAT with valid wire checksums
IPv4 options and UDP zero checksums
Established flows retain their backend during endpoint replacement
ClientIP affinity across connections and reselection after endpoint removal
Return-tuple ownership prevents another Service taking an existing translation
Direct backend traffic passes unchanged without double translation
Backend slot repacking fails closed on invalid Service membership
Empty Services and malformed packets fail closed
A one-entry forward map rejects new flows at capacity while existing flows work
Orphan reverse entries from failed publication do not translate replies
New traffic recovers after capacity is freed

scopeLimits: This gate does not prove live guest networking, policy ordering, cross-node routing, offloaded skb behavior, runtime attachment/recovery, flow garbage collection, source NAT/hairpin, IPv6 packet translation, or NodePort replacement. Hairpin and conflicting return tuples currently fail closed. Those remain part of podster-p9c before completion.
